hero.title: Experience Royal Punjabi Grills at Barbecue By Punjab Grill Malleshwaram
hero.subtitle: Indulge in the finest gourmet grills, interactive kitchens, and heartwarming live music for an unforgettable dining experience.

about.title: Our Story
about.paragraph1: Barbecue By Punjab Grill holds a fresh and unique way to make patrons experience the finest gourmet grills, with inspiration derived straight from the royal kitchens of Punjab.
about.paragraph2: Tastefully designed barbecue live stations, interactive kitchens and heart-warming live music, brings alive the most pleasurable dining experience while imbibing the essence of street dining in its ambience.
